# Hypereal AI

> > Hypereal AI provides unified API access to leading AI models including Flux, Kling, Sora, Veo, Claude, and OpenAI, with comprehensive guides for developers.

Hypereal AI is a platform offering streamlined API access to cutting-edge generative AI models for image and video generation, along with LLM integration. The site features developer guides, API documentation, free access tutorials, and comparisons of AI tools including Claude Code plugins, Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, and workflow automation.

## Key Topics

- API integration and access guides
- Hypereal AI platform and services
- Claude Code and plugins (Ralph Wiggum)
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Free AI API access methods
- AI image generation (Flux, NanoBanana Pro)
- AI video generation (Kling, Sora, Veo, SeeDream)
- OpenAI and Claude alternatives
- HTTP request formatting (multipart/form-data, x-www-form-urlencoded)
- Workflow automation (n8n)
- LLM comparisons and benchmarks
- Open-source AI tools
- DeepSeek and GLM models
- AI lip sync and video dubbing
